basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old gamer and tech enthusiast from New Jersey. I recently graduated with a degree in Computer Science and currently work as a junior developer at a tech startup. In my free time, I enjoy playing video games, especially RPGs and open-world titles. I'm also a huge fan of the New York Giants and enjoy watching travel vlogs, particularly those set in Japan. I’m single and usually online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in computer science and programming, thanks to my recent degree and self-learning through online courses. I also have a keen interest in video games and regularly follow gaming news and trends.
